idea-plugin.name: Maven Dependency Analyzer
idea-plugin.description:
Fast analysis of Maven POMs in single- and multi-module projects.
  • Parses the whole module tree once and caches the result on disk.
  • Only re-parses changed POMs and re-validates the modules affected by them.
  • Validation: XML syntax, POM structure, multi-module consistency and property references.
Open the Maven Analyzer tool window; use Full Refresh to discard the cache.

action.description: Re-parse changed POMs and re-validate affected modules
Discard the cache and re-parse every POM
